properties.note: Main-gate entrance structures traced on the NGII 2025 orthophoto (sheet 34702020; 4x chip with 1 m grid): three yellow-kerbed islands across the approach (LineString = island axis, width_m = island width, rounded ends) and the blue canopy over the lanes between them (Polygon = roof outline on the photo; the furniture stage removes the relief lean). Heights are estimates (추정): kerb 0.15 m; canopy 7.5 m from its west-cast shadow (about 4 m long at sun elevation 62 deg), minus the lean.
north island: yellow kerb ring with rounded ends, on the photo between the inbound lanes
middle island: yellow kerb ring; the canopy starts at its south side
south island: yellow kerb ring under the canopy

properties.height_source: crown of the vaults where two readings meet: on the NGII 2025 sheet the dark blocks west of the roof (one per bay) reach 3.8 m beyond the roof image, 7.9 m with the relief lean at the sun elevation of 62 deg and 7.0 m at its lower quartile 59 deg; in VR scene_a19 f the east end rib rises 67 px over the island where the 16.2 m road between the kerbs spans 172 px, about 6.3 m (5.9-6.8 m) (estimated)
properties.eave_source: spring line of each vault, a rise of about 0.7 m over its 3.7 m span as the curved end ribs show in VR scene_b1 d and r and scene_a19 f (estimated)
properties.note: parking-gate canopy over the two inbound lanes south of the middle island: two blue barrel vaults on white ribs side by side, one over the lane between GT0002 and GT0003 and one over the south lane; posts on GT0002 and GT0003 and at the south kerb (VR scene_b1 d and r, scene_a19 f)
properties.position_note: roof re-traced 2026-11-11 on the NGII 2025 sheet: the pale ribbed roof from the middle island GT0002 (north edge) and 4.6 m along the lanes, squared to the islands' bearing 105 deg; south of GT0003 its second bay reaches over the south lane to the footway (VR scene_b1 d and r), so the outline's south edge lies 0.3 m behind the south kerb face read on the sheet (bright footway to asphalt at N 263725.9 at E 244108 to N 263722.4 at E 244122, bearing 104 deg) and the south posts stand on the footway. Moved back by the relief lean for its 7.5 m height (0.41 m east, 0.52 m north), the photo's own south roof edge would stop 0.3-0.4 m short of that kerb, within the lean and the kerb-reading uncertainty; the old outline was 6 m long and stopped 1.5 m short of the kerb (estimated)
